description: Reads one note: title, folder, dates, and text as Markdown (checklists as - [ ] and - [x]). Long notes come in parts; pass offset to read on. Attached images appear as [image <id>]; pass that id as image to see the picture.

image.description: An image's id from [image <id>], to see that image

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

offset.description: Start at this character, from a previous answer

name: notes_read
title: Read a Note
